Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Fri, Nov 20 7:55am to 6:01pm; Sat, Nov 21 7:56am to 6pm; Sun, Nov 22 7:58am to 5:59pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Fri, Nov 20 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Quiet Friday. The overnight outflow is easing: Pam Rocks dropped from 19 to about 14 by 5am, too light for Porteau, and Sand Heads reads ESE 6. The page has every spot under 8kt with odds under 20%.

No real pick. The long shot is Boundary Bay from about 11am to 2pm, once the rising tide passes 10ft (high 13.5ft at 2:23pm), SE 6 to 7 on the page. Check before driving: go only if Sand Heads reads ESE 12+ by 10am.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 10:30 AM PCT 20 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Today Tonight and Saturday. Wind northerly outflow 10 to 20 knots diminishing to light near noon then increasing to northerly outflow 10 to 20 this evening. Wind increasing to northerly outflow 30 Saturday morning. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.
